description_en: Queries the list of jobs in a specified cluster
description_zh: 查询指定集群中的作业列表
name: ListJobs

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the list.
Minimum value: 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
列表的当前页码。
起始值为1
默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page when using paged query. Paging is applied to the results.
Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
列表分页查询时每页行数。
最大值：50
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The list of users who run the jobs
fields.help_zh: 执行作业的用户列表信息
fields.name: users

fields.help_en: The list of queues that run the jobs
fields.help_zh: 执行作业的队列列表信息
fields.name: queues

fields.help_en: The list of compute nodes that run the jobs
fields.help_zh: 执行作业的计算节点列表信息
fields.name: nodes

fields.help_en: The job name. Fuzzy match is supported
fields.help_zh: 作业名称。支持模糊查询
fields.name: job_name

fields.help_en:
The job status. Valid values:
all: all statuses.
finished: completed.
notfinish: not completed.

Default value: all
fields.help_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：
all：所有状态。
finished：已完成。
notfinish：未完成。

默认值：all
fields.name: job_status

fields.help_en: The start time of the job. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
fields.help_zh: 作业开始时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳，表示从 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 起所经过的秒数
fields.name: create_time_start

fields.help_en: The last update time of the job. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
fields.help_zh: 作业最后更新时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳，表示从 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 起所经过的秒数
fields.name: create_time_end

fields.help_en:
Sorts jobs by execution time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.

Default value: desc
fields.help_zh:
按照作业执行时间进行排序。取值范围：
asc：升序。
desc：降序。

默认值：desc
fields.name: execute_order

fields.help_en:
Sorts jobs by submission time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.

Default value: desc
fields.help_zh:
按照作业提交时间进行排序。取值范围：
asc：升序。
desc：降序。

默认值：desc
fields.name: submit_order

fields.help_en:
Sorts jobs by queue wait time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.

Default value: desc
fields.help_zh:
按照作业排队时间进行排序。取值范围：
asc：升序。
desc：降序。

默认值：desc
fields.name: pend_order

fields.help_en: The sorting configuration for the job list
fields.help_zh: 作业列表排序方式配置
fields.name: sort_by

element_fields.help_en: The comparison operator for the job diagnostic threshold
element_fields.name: operator
